desc: Ideate on the solution strategy using Inclusion-Exclusion on the 4 regions defined by $x<L, x>R, y<D, y>U$.
Precompute factorials and inverse factorials modulo 998244353.
Define a function `nCr(n, r)` to compute combinations.
Define a function `count_paths_in_rect(w, h)` that returns $\binom{w+h+2}{w+1} \pmod{998244353}$.
Iterate through all $2^4$ subsets of the 4 conditions.
For each subset, determine the intersection rectangle $[x_{min}, x_{max}] \times [y_{min}, y_{max}]$.
If the rectangle is valid ($x_{min} \le x_{max}$ and $y_{min} \le y_{max}$), add/subtract `count_paths_in_rect(x_max - x_min, y_max - y_min)` based on the subset size parity.
Run the code against the provided sample inputs to verify correctness.
